package player

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
)

type Controller struct {
	registry   *app.Registry
	nestClient nest.Client
}

func FromRegistry(reg *app.Registry) (*Controller, error) {
	client, ok := app.Lookup[nest.Client](reg, app.ModName("nest"))
	if !ok || client == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing Nest client")
	}
	return &Controller{registry: reg, nestClient: client}, nil
}
func (c *Controller) NestClient() nest.Client { return c.nestClient }
func (c *Controller) Registry() *app.Registry { return c.registry }
